cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: an archaeological dig site — a square excavation pit, string grids, buckets of soil, a canvas tent and a sieve
cuts.scene: she is the dig leader standing with her hands folded at the pit edge, surveying the string grids
cuts.outfit: an archaeologist look fitted to her body — a short-sleeved field shirt tied at the waist and short khaki shorts with boots and a hat, bare legs, a small bone-shaped pendant
